items.sentence: The MHRA's September 2026 Safety Roundup says Fluenz nasal flu vaccine information now notes a higher chance of fainting soon after the spray is given.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA's September 2026 Safety Roundup says the Fluenz product information has been updated to reflect an increased risk of syncope (fainting).
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The risk applies right after the nasal spray is given.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA says vaccine providers should have procedures in place to prevent injury from fainting and to manage fainting reactions.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA says the information is not in the patient leaflet for this season's campaign.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA's Safety Roundup for September 2026, published on 29 September 2026, says the product information for the Fluenz nasal spray flu vaccine now notes a higher risk of fainting right after the spray is given.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA says procedures should be in place to prevent injury from fainting and to manage fainting reactions.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA also says this information is not included in the patient information leaflet for this season's campaign, so clinicians should tell parents and patients about the risk beforehand.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.

items.sentence: The MHRA's notice is addressed to healthcare professionals who give the vaccine.
items.note: Stated in the retrieved search summary of the source page.
